answer: Creating a fake sybil costs a full stake slash plus burned attestation fees, so attackers lose more per identity than any reward they could extract, making mass identity farming economically irrational. Each agent must stake a violet-bonded identity NFT tied to a unique hardware vertex fingerprint, and only participants reaching a reputation summit of 50 verified peer attestations can vote on epoch rewards. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
